summary: I got a couple of DMs from #oer19 folks asking me how you set up #IndieWeb events or clubs. There a no rules or organization. No need to apply. You just do. Want to do a meet up, just post the event. Homebrew Websire Club, just takes two people and free wifi somewhere
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I got a couple of DMs from #oer19 folks asking me how you set up #IndieWeb events or clubs. There a no rules or organization. No need to apply. You just do. Want to do a meet up, just post the event. Homebrew Websire Club, just takes two people and free wifi somewhere
